en: Black-and-white postcard view of a central square with broad stone steps, flower beds and people sitting around. On the right stands a large, ornate multi‑storey hotel building with balconies and an inscription on the pediment reading "NÁDOR SZÁLLÓ" topped by a star. To the left is an older church-like building. The reverse side of the postcard has printed Hungarian text identifying the scene, space for a message and address, and an outlined box for a stamp.
